title: Young Couple in Formal Wear, 1940s B&W Snapshot, USA
description: Black and white full-length snapshot taken on July 5, 1948, showing a young couple posing together outdoors in formal attire. The young woman wears a ruffled white floor-length dress and hair flowers, while the young man wears dark trousers held up by suspenders over a white collared shirt. A vintage late-1940s car is parked beside them.
